test_title: PYST 05: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 06 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Tanveer starts from Point B and drives 2 km towards west. He then takes a right turn,

 drives 4 km, turns left and drives 5 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 3 km. He

 takes a final right turn, drives 7 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and

 towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point B again (all turns are

 90° turns only unless specified)?
solution:
Given,

Tanveer starts from Point B and drives 2 km towards west.

He then takes a right turn, drives 4 km, turns left, and drives 5 km.

He then takes a right turn and drives 3 km.

He takes a final right turn, drives 7 km, and stops at Point P.

The movement of Tanveer is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bddc877a06ccaee87e1eb06ba16ca7927ba4cd748452c8cc8f19646558657cb3.png] 

From the above diagram, Tanveer should drive **7 km towards South** to reach Point B again.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
